checks.description: Kogg runtime and platform information is available.
Browser authentication configuration is internally consistent.
The embedded Ranex kernel answers its health request.
The Ranex evidence journal verifies successfully.
The exclusive Kogg registry configuration is valid.
The configured signed registry is reachable and returns verifiable manifests.
Installed marketplace package pointers are readable.
The provider registry can enumerate configured adapters.
Credential metadata is readable without exposing credential contents.
The project registry schema, integrity, foreign keys, and storage permissions are valid.
Registered repository availability can be evaluated without exposing paths.
The active project and pending switch state are internally consistent.
No Kogg-owned repository probe is stalled, hidden, orphaned, or residual.
The operation registry schema, integrity, foreign keys, and permissions are valid.
Startup reconciliation completed without contradictory operation state.
No Kogg-owned process is hidden, stalled, orphaned, unverified, or residual.
Every terminal operation and owned process has proved cleanup.
Operation admission agrees with recovery and cleanup state.
The task registry schema, integrity, permissions, immutable triggers, and writer state are valid.
Task specification revisions and canonical digests verify successfully.
Task repository bindings remain current and available.
Current task approvals match immutable frozen revisions.
The exact writable-agent Linux target profile is current and qualified.
Private execution allocation records and filesystem identities agree.
Every private run repository is independent from registered source Git authority.
Registered source repositories remain unchanged across governed execution.
Every execution process scope is registered and has zero hidden or residual descendants.
Execution byte, inode, process, CPU, memory, and time reservations are within policy.
Execution startup reconciliation completed without an unknown or unowned resource.
Candidate cleanup is fenced by a durable owner decision and an unexpired fixed retention policy.
Execution backend and owner failure branches retain debugger-ready source maps.
